segments.text: Gekka-kai's student council president. She is in the same year as the protagonist but in a different class. Because of her famous family background and her elegant behavior, she will accept anyone as a member of Gekka-kai no matter who they are. Because of her figure and looks, she is very popular with the boys. But because of her high-profile treatment of others and her popularity, very few people accosted her. She also has an unexpected side of her love for cute things.
Under the alias of Ares, she plays with Kazuma in an online game, but neither of them knows their true name until it is revealed during her route.
Her being mentioned / guest appearance in PRIMAL×HEARTS 2 will only happen if you have entered Mashiro / Alicetia's route. She will be the lover of Kazuma in Mashiro’s route.

The protagonist's kouhai. Even though she's just a freshman, she managed to become Tendou-kai's student council president. Loves interesting things, she wants to make school life more interesting. Despite the fact that her appearance is petite, there is no doubt about her qualities as the president of Tendou-kai. She has creativity that goes beyond common sense, along with keen insight and leadership, through which she has gained a lot of support from the students. She cannot accurately understand love yet.
Her guest appearance in PRIMAL×HEARTS 2 will only happen if you have entered Usagi’s route. She will be the lover of Kazuma in Usagi’s route.

The protagonist's classmate and Gekka-kai's secretary. Cheerful and lively girl, she is responsible for the atmosphere in the Gekka-kai. Perhaps it is because she is like this, her social relationships is very wide, no matter which student council supporters, she is able to communicate with them. She will often take walks with her dog after school or work at the local coffee shop. When she is working, customers often come to see her because of her cute appearance and cheerful personality.
Her guest appearance in PRIMAL×HEARTS 2 will only happen if you have entered Tateha's route. She will be the lover of Kazuma in Tateha's route.

The protagonist's senpai. Gentle and good at taking care of others, she is the perfect onee-san. Perhaps it is because of her maternal instincts, she will often accept people's request for advice. She is very popular among the students, and has both male and female supporters. She is the vice president of Tendou-kai, and her main responsibility is helping Haruhi. Why she didn't become the president is the biggest question on campus. Very good at cooking, recently became engrossed in making sweets.
Her guest appearance in PRIMAL×HEARTS 2 will only happen if you have entered Alicetia's route. She will be the lover of Kazuma in Alicetia's route.
The protagonist. Because of various circumstances, he transferred to Ainoshima Gakuen during May. He wants to use this opportunity to get a pretty girlfriend.
It was revealed his original name:
"Narukami Kazuma(鳴神和馬)"

The protagonist's homeroom teacher. Although she is the advisor for Gekka-kai, the members are always the ones taking care of the affairs, so her being the advisor is in name only. She is a self-centered woman with little dignity as a teacher. Because of this the students are like her friends.

The protagonist's classmate and the Tendou-kai student council secretary. He is an overweight otaku. Seems to want other people to call him "Nori Nori no Nori-san", but everyone just ignores him. Loves anime and games, and has knowledge on a wide range of miscellaneous things.

segments.text: Alicetia Wallenberg Kezouji doesn't quite fit in, not even with the cats she feeds. She does tend to mutter and glare when she talks, which has earned her the nickname Ms. Evil One. She holds Gekka's presidency by her pedigree and unintentional terror.
From Shiravune
Class: 2-D
Hobbies: Making sweets
Gekka-kai's student council president.

WOOOOO! Usagi Tsukiyono is a popstar idol with the whole school wrapped around her little finger. Scratch the surface of her pep and you might find more complexity; perhaps someone more devious, more down-to-earth... But nobody scratches the president of Tendo!
From Shiravune
Hobbies: Shopping
Tendou-kai's student council president.

Mashiro Kuryu serves as the face of Gekka where Alicetia can't and keeps Ainoshima's flowerbeds well watered. A somewhat sheltered girl who cares dearly for her friends, she might prove surprisingly assertive in the pursuit of something—or somebody—she wants.
From Shiravune
Class: 1-D
Gekka-kai's vice president. Her hobbies include taking care of flowers, as she takes care of the school's backyard's flowers.

Tateha Tatebayashi is the niece of the enigmatic owner of the café Rapunzel—and she works Yuzuki's old job there after school. She's sweet, upbeat, and kindhearted, and with a little confidence, she could compete with the most eccentric of her Tendo council mates!
From Shiravune
Same year and class as the Protagonist. Tendou-kai's secretary. During her free time, she helps out at her uncle's cafe.
In her route, after Yuzuki's appearance, she says that she has always admired Yuzuki and wants to be like her since young.

Bitch-san's younger brother. On the advice of his older sister, Daichi transferred into her school. His heart was full of expectation for a new life, at least until he crossed the school gates where he was accosted by the two student council leaders.
They say 777 is lucky, but to Daichi, who had planned to spend a quiet school life, it was extremely unlucky.
From Hau~ Omochikaeri!
Tatewaki Kazuma, protagonist of the 1st game, is his martial art teacher.
A slightly mysterious classmate of Daichi's.
She is part of the broadcasting committee. She is this generation's Vote DJ.
Class: 3-C
Tendou-kai's student council vice president who is completely devoted to Usagi.

Daichi's older sister and a graduate of Ainoshima Academy. She is also the one that reformed Daichi from being a recluse and recommended him to transfer to Ainoshima Academy. She may look gaudy and loose but is actually a domestic and caring person. The people around her still call her by her nickname "Slut."
Class: 3-C
Tendou-kai's accountant who is always listening to music. He is usually quiet but becomes more talkative when the subject of music (especially German metal) is brought up.
Hobbies: Building muscle
Taichi's classmate and the secretary of Gekka-kai.
Usagi's mother.
